spec: Ambient cast registry for The Mission. Mirrors SF_AMBIENT_ROUTINES in src/sf/33_sf_cast.js — this JSON is the readable spec, the JS is the implementation; edit them together. 'poi' values use canonical parody names resolved by SF_WORLD_POIS in src/sf/30_sf_world.js; 'anchor' values are SF_MAP.anchors keys; 'home' is the hashed sfAmbientHome cell. v43 adds the ambient-week contract: per-ambient 'signature' (silhouette/gait/carry — the feed-legible read), 'week' day-keyed routine rows for days that differ from the base routine (off days, personal days), 'weather' alternate rows per condition that changes the day, and 'personal' recurring life-texture conditions. Variants are conditions, not scripts — the thin-AI resolver picks the day's row set; base 'routine' stays the fallback and the 33_sf_cast.js mirror. v57 adds the fog/wind variant answers — every ambient carries a fog entry (rows where the gray moves the day, a note where it doesn't); the stand, the pitch, and the paper-bag routines carry wind.

conventions.possession: ambient NPCs are never possessable (design §9); minors A04/A20 are never request targets
conventions.crowd_model: two-layer population contract (named ambients + unnamed extras): world/crowd.json + world/crowd-sim.md (v15)
conventions.ambient_week: per-ambient signature/week/weather/personal blocks — resolved by the thin tier, demoed in crowd.html v4 (v43)
conventions.variant_rows: same schema as routine rows ({h0,h1,to|stops,state,inside}); a 'week' or 'weather' entry REPLACES the day's rows only where the day differs — unspecified hours fall through to the base routine? No: a variant row set covers the full 24h when present.

ambients.name: Reyes
ambients.role: barista pulling espresso shifts

sun.note: the only morning past 9 — laundry, groceries, and some Sundays a catering gig that takes the whole day

storm.note: work is indoors; the shift doesn't move

fog.note: the line is the same length gray or gold — the shift doesn't move

personal.note: stops at the minimart counter for one lottery ticket on the walk home — the whole wager, every week

ambients.name: Doro
ambients.role: dog-walker with a leash hand

sun.note: half book — Sundays the clients' owners walk their own

rain.note: loops halve; the dogs don't vote

storm.note: storm days the walks cancel — she calls it, not the dogs

fog.note: fog is the default morning — the dogs don't vote on it either

wind.note: wind is the dogs' favorite — every ear up, same loops

ambients.name: Malik
ambients.role: corner-shop keeper

signature.carry: pricing gun in the apron pocket

rain.note: same hours — the sidewalk crates come in and the doorway narrows

fog.note: door open either way; fog sells coffee, not umbrellas

personal.note: stocks the register with small bills before opening — he knows what the 1st does to the block

ambients.name: June
ambients.role: student hauling a tote of books

signature.carry: a tote bag heavier than she is

sat.note: no school — the park orbit runs all day

sun.note: Sunday is the long mango-and-homework loop

rain.note: the park swap is the awnings — Mudhaus window or the library, never the grass

fog.note: a gray afternoon reads cold on the bench — the pack studies at Mudhaus and drifts home earlier

personal.note: exam weeks: the 15–19 stop moves to the library — Vera holds the same table

ambients.name: Esther
ambients.role: retiree on a stoop, watching the block

rain.note: rain moves the parliament indoors — Dolores Perk table by the window, shorter day

storm.note: storms she watches from her own window

fog.note: the parliament convenes at the Perk till it burns — usually by eleven; on an all-day fog the window table holds

personal.note: parliament runs long on the 1st — everybody walks past the bench eventually

ambients.name: Kofe
ambients.role: delivery rider with a hot box

sat.note: weekend surge — later start, later finish

rain.note: same loop, faster — rain raises the order count, not the pace limit

fog.note: same loop; the foghorn is somebody else's problem

personal.note: Friday and Saturday dinner surges tighten the loop to the restaurants — no park-adjacent stops

ambients.name: Luz
ambients.role: street vendor at a fruit stand

signature.carry: a paring knife and a produce scale
signature.tell: the mango slice appears before the greeting does

rain.note: tarp over the stand, half day — gone by early afternoon

storm.note: the stand doesn't open in a storm

heat.note: heat stretches the day — she sells out late and closes late

fog.note: fog means dew — the stand opens a half hour late and dries the crates first, closes an hour early when the gray holds

wind.note: high wind packs the stand early — the scale and the tarps don't argue with gusts

personal.note: the 1st is her biggest day — extra crates before dawn, sold through by afternoon

ambients.name: Sam
ambients.role: busker with a guitar on the corner

signature.tell: sets up without looking at the crowd

sat.note: Saturday starts an hour earlier — weekend crowds pay

sun.note: same — Sunday afternoon is the best pitch of the week

rain.note: doorway sets — the 600 Club awning, smaller crowd, better music

storm.note: storm days the park is dead — he's at the bar by noon anyway

fog.note: a gray park still tips — the pitch doesn't move for fog

wind.note: wind moves the pitch to the 600 Club doorway — you can't tune a gust

ambients.name: Asha
ambients.role: nurse in scrubs off a shift
ambients.codeNameNote: NV_CAST name was 'Priya' through v0 — renamed 'Asha' in pa-chars.js at v1 (collision with C4 Priya Raman).

tue.note: off shift — errands at walking-decompression speed

heat.note: heat waves fill the ward — same hours, longer day inside

fog.note: the ward doesn't have weather

personal.note: after a shift she takes the Mudhaus counter seat facing the door, phone down, one drink — this is the whole ritual

ambients.name: Gus
ambients.role: mechanic in oil-stained overalls

signature.carry: a rag that lives in the pocket

sun.note: shop closed Sundays — breakfast at the Perk, then the couch

rain.note: rain fills the shop — nobody wants to be under a car in their driveway

fog.note: the shop is indoors; fog changes nothing but the light through the door

ambients.name: Vera
ambients.role: librarian shelving returns

signature.carry: a returns cart she isn't pushing

sun.note: library closed — she reads in the park like a civilian

mon.note: Monday closure — same bench, different book

rain.note: rain doubles the library — her park hour goes to the overflow at the door

fog.note: fog is library weather — the chairs fill either way

ambients.name: Tom
ambients.role: jogger doing laps around the park

rain.note: rain shortens the laps, never the schedule — one lap fewer, same times

storm.note: a storm is the only thing that cancels him — he hates it visibly

fog.note: the metronome doesn't check the sky — same laps, same times

wind.note: into the wind is still a lap

personal.note: Thursdays he runs intervals — the only day the metronome syncopates

ambients.name: Nadia
ambients.role: tech worker doom-scrolling on the curb

signature.carry: a laptop in a padded sleeve
signature.tell: headphones go on when it gets loud

rain.note: rain is a home day — the corner table stays empty

storm.note: same — plus the window open an inch for the sound

fog.note: a gray morning is a home morning — she comes out when it burns, mid-morning

ambients.name: Bex
ambients.role: tattoo artist on a smoke break
ambients.venue: Needlepointe Tattoo + Clarion Alley; The 600 Club
ambients.secretAdjacent: Recognizes the chalkboard/Clarion linework match (C3-adjacent). Ambient = never says it; promotion makes her a live discovery path.

signature.tell: smoke-break consults at the shop door

mon.note: shop dark Mondays — she wanders the alley anyway, it's where the walls are

rain.note: the alley wall doesn't happen in rain — shop door only

fog.note: fog is good skin weather; the shop door opens on time

ambients.name: Omar
ambients.role: bike courier with a messenger bag

signature.carry: the paper bag that outlives the route

rain.note: fenders on, pace identical — paper doesn't wait for weather

storm.note: storm halves the run — only the stops that pay double stay on the list

fog.note: pace identical — glasses on, head down

ambients.name: Hana
ambients.role: baker carrying warm trays

signature.tell: the 5 a.m. head-tilt at the oven

mon.note: bakery dark Mondays — the one morning she sees daylight

heat.note: heat cuts the bake short — ovens off by 11, out the door

rain.note: rain keeps her in — the errands wait, the day-old shelf goes half price

fog.note: the ovens don't notice; fog is just the morning

ambients.name: Cole
ambients.role: construction worker on a scaffold

signature.carry: a thermos the size of a forearm

sat.note: Saturdays he still ends up at the hardware counter — personal projects

sun.note: Sunday is the flat day — nobody expects him anywhere

rain.note: rain moves the crew to interior work — same hours, different scaffold

fog.note: interior or exterior, the thermos is the same

ambients.name: Ida
ambients.role: florist with a basket of bouquets

signature.tell: hands a stray stem to strangers

mon.note: shop dark Mondays — she walks the alley to see what the week did to the walls

rain.note: the buckets come in off the sidewalk — the storefront shrinks

fog.note: fog is free watering — the sidewalk buckets stay out

ambients.name: Ray
ambients.role: retired longshoreman feeding pigeons

signature.tell: claims the bench by standing next to it

rain.note: rain retires him early — the pigeons get one wet pass and no parliament

storm.note: storms he sits in his own window and disapproves

fog.note: Perk window till it burns, then the bench — the pigeons wait; on an all-day fog the pigeons get one wet pass and he retires early

wind.note: the crumbs stay bagged till the gusts pass — the pigeons know why

personal.note: the pigeons know 8:30 and noon — he is never late to either

ambients.name: Zee
ambients.role: teenager glued to a phone

signature.carry: a phone held like a camera

sat.note: weekend perimeter — pack orbit, all day

sun.note: Sunday the pack drifts south — Luz's end of the park

rain.note: rain compresses the perimeter to the Mudhaus awning and home earlier

fog.note: gray days the perimeter orbit compresses to the Mudhaus awning, home earlier

promotion_note: v126: A05/A09/A14 promoted to supporting residents S2/S3/S1 (characters/supporting/); ids stay frozen, ambient-era cards remain the thin-era record. Roster slots remain A-ids — do not respawn.
